subject: Post-renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion verification - AvaTech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Richardson <paul.richardson@avatech.com>, Lila Park <lila.park@avatech.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion verification - AvaTech

Hi Paul / Lila,

Congrats again on completing the renewal — excited to have AvaTech on the expanded Dedicated pool. Per the SOW we provisioned an additional 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved pool: ava-prod-resv-02) and enabled the throughput guarantee of 1500 tokens/sec for your primary inference route.

Next steps for verification (proposal):
- Tuesday 2026-03-10 14:00 PT: load test sprint (our infra team will drive)
- Deliverable: a CSV of run-level metrics (attached) and a short pass/fail acceptance form to be returned signed
- Post-test: Redwood provides a 48-hour monitoring window where we keep the expanded pool pinned and collect metrics; we’ll share dashboards and alerts

Can you confirm that the SRE/QA folks below (Paul/Lila) are able to join the test at 14:00 PT? I’ve attached the acceptance form and a skeleton runbook for monitoring.

Attachments: avatech_load_test_results.csv (template), capacity_acceptance_form.pdf, runbook-monitoring-notes.md

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Paul Richardson <paul.richardson@avatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lila Park <lila.park@avatech.com>
Cc: procurement@avatech.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion verification - AvaTech

Marissa — thanks for the plan. Lila and I joined the load sprint and ran three steady-state runs against the new pool. Summary below:

Run summary (high-level):
- Target throughput: 1500 tokens/sec (sustained)
- Observed median: 1,480 tokens/sec, 95th pctile: 1,550 tokens/sec during warmup spikes
- Average latency per request: 78 ms (within SLA target 100 ms)
- Error rate: 0.1% (two transient 503s during warmup, both recovered)

I attached the detailed CSV export (avatech_load_test_results.csv). We also filled the acceptance form and marked conditional acceptance pending a short monitoring window (48 hours) and a follow-up checkpoint.

Notes: the oscillation to 1,550 TPS happened during concurrent large-sequence runs; we recommend Redwood look at autoscale thresholds for burst traffic so the pool doesn’t hit transient 503s.

Attachment: avatech_load_test_results.csv (full run metrics), capacity_acceptance_form.pdf (filled)

—Paul
Paul Richardson
SRE Lead, AvaTech
paul.richardson@avatech.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Paul Richardson <paul.richardson@avatech.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion verification - AvaTech

Thanks Paul — good detail. Priyom / Infra: can you review the CSV and confirm whether the two transient 503s correlate with the autoscale throttle settings on ava-prod-resv-02? Quick checklist for sign-off: 

- [ ] Confirmed 48-hour monitoring window is active and dashboards capturing tokens/sec, latency P50/P95/P99, and 503/4xx counts
- [ ] Autoscale burst buffer set to 20% headroom for peak concurrency (tweak if needed)
- [ ] Retention of logs for 30 days for this pool
- [ ] Documented runbook for SRE handoff (see runbook-monitoring-notes.md)

Priyom — if infra is good with the above, can we mark the acceptance form as "Signed — conditional" and copy that back to procurement@avatech.com so they can close the order in their system? I’ll coordinate a 24-hour and 48-hour check-in (Grafana link below).

Grafana (live): https://grafana.avatest.example/d/throughput/avatech-expanded-pool?from=now-1h
Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.inference/display/ENG/AvaTech+post-renewal

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Richardson <paul.richardson@avatech.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@avatech.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion verification - AvaTech

Paul / team — appreciate the detailed runs and the filled acceptance form. We’ve reviewed the CSV and Priyom confirmed the transient 503s were during a short burst where autoscale handoff lagged by ~12s; infra increased the burst buffer to 25% and we’ve re-run a targeted warmup; no further 503s observed in the most recent 2 runs.

Per our standard process, I’m signing off: AvaTech acceptance = SIGNED (conditional monitoring window: 48 hours). Procurement, please accept the attached capacity_acceptance_form.pdf into your system to finalize the order.

Monitoring plan:
- Redwood keeps the reserved pool pinned for 48 hours (Mar 11 11:00 PT — Mar 13 11:00 PT)
- Automated alerts configured for 503 spike > 0.5% sustained over 5m, latency P95 > 120 ms
- Weekly health digest to SRE + CSM for the first month

Attachments: capacity_acceptance_form.pdf (signed)

Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
